entities.summary: Merrell Vories Hitotsuyanagi, also known as Mereru Hitotsuyanagi ; born William Merrell Vories, was an educator, architect, entrepreneur, Christian lay missionary, and founder of the Omi Mission. Born in the United States, he later became a naturalized Japanese citizen.
